summary: Reproduced that generation health probes mutate DataParallelController user routing state before scheduler admission, then isolated probes behind an independent active-worker round-robin path. Probes remain real requests sent to schedulers, while user round-robin position, total-request estimates, total-token estimates, and load-budget refresh state are unchanged. The implementation adapts the still-open upstream candidate PR #35721 and adds direct counter/interleaving assertions.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression: health probes advanced shared round-robin routing and incremented DPBudget total_requests/total_tokens. Four new tests failed on the checked-out implementation.

25 unit tests passed. Coverage measures user/probe interleavings, independent round-robin counters, unchanged DPBudget request/token counters, health-only batch refresh suppression, active-worker selection, explicit DP routing, bootstrap-room routing, and actual worker dispatch for scheduler admission. Raw output: reports/j-fa6cb4f00321/raw/pytest-data-parallel-controller.txt
